sentences.text:
Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 The Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.13884 Of 2024
Order :

(ORAL) This writ petition is filed by the petitioners seeking to declare the action of respondent No.4 - The Station House Officer, Huzurnagar, Suryapet District, in not providing Police protection to the petitioner and his family members and not completing the investigation in Crime No.22 of 2024 of Huzurnagar, Police Station, as being illegal and arbitrary.

2. Heard Mr. Laxmaiah Kanchani, learned Counsel for the petitioners; and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, and perused the material on record.
3.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, having received written instructions, submitted that investigation has been completed in Crime No.22 of 2024 of Huzurnagar Police Station and charge sheet has been filed under Sections 498A, 326, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 and Calendar Case (C.C.) number is awaited.
4.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home submitted that in so far as Police protection is concerned, petitioner is always at liberty to approach Police Station or dial 100 and Police would take necessary action as per the law.
5. A copy of written instructions, section alteration memo and charge sheet is served on learned counsel for the petitioner.

6. Recording the aforesaid submissions of the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, this writ petition is disposed of, giving liberty to the petitioner to approach respondent No.4 - The Station House Officer, Huzurnagar Police Station or dial 100 as and when there are specific instances of threat or criminal intimidation from the accused persons in Crime No.22 of 2024 of Huzurnagar Police Station.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in the writ petition stand closed.
B. VIJAYSEN REDDY, J Date: 12.06.2024 MS Dondapati Ram Reddy vs The State Of Telangana on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69695001/
